specifications.title: Mixed cash/electronic checkout cannot confirm its electronic leg
specifications.root_cause: CheckoutOrderHandler.cs (line 148) posts the cash tender leg using idempotency key 'sale-{CheckoutRequestId}'. When ConfirmElectronicPaymentHandler.cs (line 75) attempts to post the deferred electronic split leg, it attempts to insert into EfFinancialJournal using the exact same key 'sale-{CheckoutRequestId}', throwing a unique constraint violation.
specifications.impact: Split payment completion failure. Cash is accepted and deposited into the drawer, but the electronic leg (InstaPay/Card) can never be confirmed on the server; the order remains stuck in pending payment state.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Key journal entries by stable leg identity, e.g. 'sale-{CheckoutRequestId}-{TenderType}'. Transition pending electronic leg atomically to confirmed.
required_regression_tests: Mixed cash+InstaPay and card+Wallet checkout, confirmation, retry, and concurrent confirm; verify exact tender totals and one movement per leg.
Replay same request and verify stable movement identity.
acceptance_criteria: Each tender leg can complete independently and exactly once.
Confirmed electronic state and its movement commit atomically; channel totals reconcile.

specifications.title: Cancelling pending mixed electronic payment hides collected cash without reversal
specifications.root_cause: Order.cs:CancelElectronicPayment sets order Status to Cancelled without issuing a reversal journal entry for cash tender legs that were already deposited into the till drawer at checkout.
specifications.impact: Treasury divergence. Drawer cash remains physically and logically deposited, but order disappears from sales reports, causing shift drawer reconciliation discrepancies.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: When cancelling a mixed tender order, check if any cash leg was deposited and atomically post a reversal journal movement to the drawer.
required_regression_tests: Cancel cash+electronic and card+electronic orders; reconcile treasury, operational cash, and reports.
Race cancel against confirm and require one terminal tender outcome.
Verify refund only when funds are actually returned.
acceptance_criteria: Cancelled order/payment state preserves every collected tender until a matching reversal exists.
Order, tender, treasury, and report totals reconcile after either winning race.

specifications.title: Refund can debit money for an order that was never collected
specifications.root_cause: Order.cs:ApplyRefund and RefundOrderHandler.cs do not verify that the order was actually settled (IsPaid == true) before approving a cash refund.
specifications.impact: Cash drain. An operator can issue a cash refund against an unpaid Cash-On-Delivery order or pending InstaPay order, draining drawer funds for money never collected.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Enforce invariant in Order.ApplyRefund that order must be fully collected (IsPaid == true) and refund amount cannot exceed collected tender.
required_regression_tests: Unpaid COD, pending electronic, confirmed paid, partial collected, and unsupported mixed cases.
Race refund with cancel/confirm and concurrent refunds; rejected cases create no refund/movement and balances remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Cumulative refunds never exceed the order’s actually settled amount per tender leg.
Rejected unpaid refund leaves no partial writes; valid refund atomically records refund and outflow.

specifications.title: Concurrent distinct invoice settlements can overpay supplier and corrupt invoice cache
specifications.root_cause: PayPurchaseHandler.cs (lines 59-74) reads supplier invoice balance without UPDLOCK or serializable isolation, allowing concurrent transactions to each read the remaining balance before either updates it.
specifications.impact: Supplier overpayment and invoice balance corruption under concurrent settlement clicks.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Execute invoice settlement within an explicit Serializable transaction or apply pessimistic locking (UPDLOCK, ROWLOCK) on the purchasing invoice record.
required_regression_tests: Barrier: two different 80 settlements against outstanding 100, both same account and different accounts; at most one succeeds, total <=100 and cache equals ledger.
Same request replay returns committed result.
acceptance_criteria: For each invoice, committed settlements never exceed current outstanding.
Cached paid/outstanding fields match ledger under serialized settlements.
Retries remain idempotent and deadlock policy is bounded.

specifications.title: Unvalidated signed delivery fee can bypass intended discount and comp authorization
specifications.root_cause: CheckoutOrderHandler.cs (line 142) accepts request.DeliveryFeePiastres directly from client payload without verifying against DeliveryService.DefaultFee or checking manager authorization.
specifications.impact: Delivery fee tampering. A client can supply negative or zero delivery fee to discount an order without triggering manager discount authorization.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Validate delivery fee server-side against configured delivery rates or require manager override for non-standard delivery fees.
required_regression_tests: Negative fee with ordinary POS actor; overflow boundaries; assert no writes.
Positive/zero fee, tax, approved comp, COD and legitimate discounts.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid signed fee and arithmetic overflow rejected before any order, stock, journal or treasury write.
Valid positive/zero fees and approved discount/comp routes retain policy behavior.

specifications.title: Split Payment Electronic Split Ceiling Restriction
specifications.root_cause: CheckoutRules.SelectElectronicLeg assumes at most one electronic leg in a split payment, discarding all subsequent electronic legs via .First().
specifications.impact: Secondary electronic payments are not tracked as pending claims, leaving order in partially confirmed state and losing money reconciliation trace.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Refactor Order and CheckoutPlan to support IReadOnlyList<ElectronicPayment> or enforce single-electronic split limit during checkout preflight.
required_regression_tests: Checkout split payment with InstaPay and Wallet legs; verify both legs are tracked in order electronic payments collection.
acceptance_criteria: Multi-tender orders with multiple electronic splits preserve all electronic claims without truncation.

specifications.title: JSON actor casing mismatch permits body-selected authorization identity
specifications.root_cause: In AuthenticationMiddleware.cs (lines 86-133), FindActorMismatchAsync uses case-sensitive TryGetProperty("actorUserId", out _) against lowercase string names. An incoming JSON payload with PascalCase 'ActorUserId' silently bypasses the mismatch check. Minimal API model binding in Program.cs (lines 1951-1958) binds case-insensitively into UpdateUserPermissionsRequest.ActorUserId. UpdateUserPermissionsHandler.cs (lines 32-36) queries DB for request.ActorUserId and authorizes the operation using that user's permissions instead of context.ActorId() from the verified bearer session token.
specifications.impact: Source-Proven: Complete privilege escalation. Any authenticated user holding a valid session token (even cashier or low-privilege employee) can grant themselves arbitrary permissions (including users_manage, orders_refund, all) by supplying 'ActorUserId': 'usr-admin' in PascalCase on POST /api/users/{id}/permissions. (Prior claim of arbitrary JSON Actor object injection was inaccurate and is refuted by wire DTO definitions).
specifications.implementation_blueprint:
1. In AuthenticationMiddleware.cs, parse request body using case-insensitive property name matching (e.g. EnumerateObject() with StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase).
2. Refactor Program.cs endpoint and UpdateUserPermissionsHandler to eliminate ActorUserId from wire DTOs and bind authorized caller identity exclusively from context.ActorId() established by token session resolution.
required_regression_tests: Submit POST /api/users/{targetId}/permissions with token for low-privilege cashier and body containing 'ActorUserId': 'usr-admin'; assert HTTP 403 Forbidden.
Verify case variations ('actorUserId', 'ActorUserId', 'ACTORUSERID') all trigger actor mismatch rejection in middleware.
Verify UpdateUserPermissionsHandler authorizes against authenticated session user even if body attempts to provide ActorUserId.
acceptance_criteria: AuthenticationMiddleware rejects any mismatched actor identity regardless of JSON key casing.
Handlers never read or trust client-supplied actor user ID from request body.

specifications.title: Shift Close Identity Spoofing via Unchecked ClosedByUserId
specifications.root_cause: AuthenticationMiddleware.ActorFields defines ['actorUserId', 'cashierId', 'createdByUserId', 'openedByUserId', 'reportedByUserId'] but omits 'closedByUserId'. When CloseShiftRequest is processed, the middleware performs no mismatch check against the authenticated user token, permitting arbitrary identity spoofing during shift closure.
specifications.impact: Any authenticated till operator can unilaterally close shifts belonging to other cashiers, assigning cash discrepancies, drawer shortages, or uncollected delivery tickets to innocent colleagues.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Add 'closedByUserId' to ActorFields in AuthenticationMiddleware.cs, or inject HttpContext.ActorId() directly in Minimal API endpoint binding.
required_regression_tests: Send CloseShiftRequest with ClosedByUserId differing from authenticated token; assert HTTP 403 Forbidden is returned.
Verify legitimate shift close succeeds when ClosedByUserId matches token identity.
acceptance_criteria: Shift close requires caller identity matching authenticated bearer token.

specifications.title: Session Token Replacement & Identity Confusion in PIN Replay Proof
specifications.root_cause: LoginByPinAsync has the side effect of mutating the shared ApiClient session token. Using it as a credential verification probe overwrites the logged-in operator's token.
specifications.impact: Session hijacking and identity confusion: subsequent till operations are executed under the credential being verified rather than the active cashier's identity.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Implement dedicated POST /api/auth/verify-pin endpoint that validates PIN without issuing or mutating session tokens.
required_regression_tests: Replay retained PIN change request; assert active session token on ApiClient remains unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: PIN verification during offline request replay does not alter client session credentials.

specifications.title: Historical cash refund omitted from current-shift expected cash
specifications.root_cause: Drawer mixes lifetime order net amounts with selected operational movement types and does not allocate refunds by OperationalShiftId.
specifications.impact: A cash refund executed during current shift B for a sale from shift A may reduce lifetime/order net while the drawer reconciliation for B omits the refund outflow or allocates it to the original sale; expected cash and actual drawer diverge.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Compute drawer flow from posted operational cash movements or join refund rows by OperationalShiftId; avoid double deduction for same-shift refunds and preserve immutable closed shift snapshots. Separate original sale period from refund execution period.
required_regression_tests: Historical shift A sale refunded in B; verify B actual/expected and final close balance reconcile.
Same-shift partial cash refund counted exactly once.
Historic noncash refund and cross-business-day reports preserve attribution; idempotent retry.
acceptance_criteria: Each refund cash outflow appears once in the shift/business period in which it was executed.
Historical closed shift snapshot remains immutable; current operational drawer reconciles to movements.

specifications.title: Generic payroll transition marks run Paid without paying treasury or employee ledger
specifications.root_cause: TransitionPayrollHandler.cs permits generic status transition of an approved payroll run directly to 'Paid' without generating corresponding treasury journal disbursements or employee ledger settlement entries.
specifications.impact: Payroll status marked Paid without actual money leaving treasury or settling employee balances.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Disallow transition to Paid via generic TransitionPayrollHandler. Require execution exclusively through PayPayrollHandler which generates atomic treasury and ledger entries.
required_regression_tests: Generic Approved->Paid is rejected and writes nothing.
Dedicated pay atomically creates expected movement and each settlement.
Actor without payroll_pay cannot set Paid through generic route.
Concurrent cancel/pay results in exactly one consistent terminal state.
acceptance_criteria: Paid status is equivalent to completed committed payout effects.
No API path can mark paid without required payroll_pay authorization and all financial rows.

specifications.title: Restore pending-journal check does not exclude active or newly accepted financial work
specifications.root_cause: Pending journal staged and completed before common SaveChanges cannot reliably reveal in-flight work; a count snapshot is not writer exclusion. Restore does not put API/print/background writers into maintenance barrier.
specifications.impact: Restore’s pending-journal check does not exclude active or newly accepted writes. Restore may enter SINGLE_USER/replace while acknowledged financial operation or background writer is in flight; recovery of latest acknowledged work is not assured by the current check.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Use a database-backed maintenance admission lease respected by all mutating handlers and background workers; drain in-flight operations, pause workers, take safety backup, restore and verify, clear stale pools/caches/sessions as designed, then resume only after durable outcome recording.
required_regression_tests: Pure coordinator test: after maintenance lease acquired, new writes are rejected and prior writes drained.
Dedicated disposable instance restore with approved fault injection and proof of last acknowledged sale recovery.
Exercise job/API writers and restore failures; never use user-active database.
acceptance_criteria: Restore cannot begin until writers are excluded/drained.
Every accepted operation is either included in pre-restore safety point or has an explicit replay/recovery record.
Failure leaves a known healthy database and maintenance mode controlled.

specifications.title: Shift opening and purchase receipt check protected account balance before their transactions
specifications.root_cause: UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK loader invoked before BeginTransaction; statement-end implicit transaction releases lock, balance snapshot stale at spending. SingleOpen index protects only shift rows.
specifications.impact: Shift opening float and/or purchase receipt may authorize against stale Main account balance because protective lock query occurs before transaction; competing outflow may spend same available funds, potentially allowing negative pooled account or failed/partial admission.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Start transaction before protected account balance load/check and hold lock through float/receipt writes; establish consistent account/shift/invoice lock order; make retries safe and preserve real concurrency errors.
required_regression_tests: Barrier-controlled open-float versus withdrawal/expense/purchase distinct requests; account never negative and exactly feasible operation set commits.
Same open request replay and single-active-shift invariant still hold.
Verify purchase receipt document/inventory/financial rows atomic.
acceptance_criteria: Protected balance read and spend are in one transaction with effective lock lifetime.
No successful concurrent commits exceed available balance; rejected command has no partial effects.

specifications.title: Attendance correction credits do not enter calculated payroll
specifications.root_cause: Correction records signed Adjustment entries; payroll includes Adjustment debits only, with no credit earnings bucket.
specifications.impact: A positive attendance correction recorded as Adjustment credit may be ignored by payroll’s included earnings/deduction categories, so the corrected employee period net can remain lower than ledger balance.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Reconcile both credit and debit sides of Adjustment into payroll net; preserve correction attribution and original earning basis if required; keep payroll freeze semantics explicit.
required_regression_tests: Payroll input with prior Deduction debit plus correcting Adjustment credit restores expected net.
Attendance correction followed by payroll calculation and report agrees with employee ledger.
Correction before run creation and after run freeze follow documented policy.
acceptance_criteria: Every eligible period employee-ledger credit/debit included exactly once in payroll liability.
Payroll line and ledger are consistent; post-freeze correction follows explicit reopen/adjustment policy.

specifications.title: Restore success followed by MULTI_USER failure is classified as database not replaced
specifications.root_cause: databaseWasReplaced becomes true only after RESTORE and MULTI_USER both return. If restore159 succeeded and MULTI_USER164 throws/cancels, catch releases mode best-effort but leaves false flag and Failed status.
specifications.impact: Operator may be told restore failed after database replacement; RecordOutcome false branch does not re-add disappeared restore row or clear killed connection pool. Incorrect outcome can encourage a dangerous retry. Actual failure at this precise boundary has not been produced.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Track restore replacement separately from recovery/availability state; persist explicit replaced-but-recovery-incomplete outcome outside replaced database. Resolve uncertain SQL acknowledgments through a recovery protocol; do not auto-retry destructive restore.
required_regression_tests: Fake coordinator injects failure/cancellation after RESTORE but before/during MULTI_USER.
Approved disposable-instance fault injection verifies replaced database is never reported untouched and no automatic retry occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Restore command outcome distinguishes database replacement from return to MULTI_USER/availability; partial success is durably recorded outside replaced DB.
Injected post-RESTORE mode failure never reports database untouched and never triggers automatic retry.

specifications.title: Checkout can commit after its previously open shift has completed handover
specifications.root_cause: Open shift predicate read before checkout transaction is not revalidated/held through commit; closing uses a different correctly locked Shift update that checkout does not perform.
specifications.impact: Recorded closed shift expected/actual/handover exclude newly committed cash order while order and posted drawer collection reference that closed shift; new order time can be later than ClosedAtUtc. Stock can also be consumed when configured. No cash loss, fraud, exploit, or accepted real write observed.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Serialize checkout admission and shift close with a shared transaction-held Shift row protocol: lock/revalidate Open before writes, hold through commit; alternatively use a documented Closing/drain process. Preserve closed snapshots.
required_regression_tests: Barrier after checkout shift read and before transaction; close then resume checkout: reject with zero order/payment/stock effects.
Reverse ordering: checkout admission held; close waits and includes sale.
Same-key replay after close remains nonmutating.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh checkout and shift close serialize through shared shift admission; every accepted checkout is included in handover or rejected with no effects.
Same-key replay after close remains idempotent and nonmutating.

specifications.title: Pending mixed delivery includes already collected payment leg in driver custody
specifications.root_cause: Delivery responsibility collapses per-leg payment collection into one whole-order IsPaid flag and Total-refund. Mixed pending order is partially collected, but modeled as wholly uncollected for driver custody.
specifications.impact: Overstated driver collection/custody by already posted immediate leg; possible duplicate customer collection or artificial driver variance/approval requirement. No claim actual customer payment, cash theft, SQL acceptance or persisted double revenue was reproduced.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Use per-tender-leg collection status/amount when deriving driver custody. Do not reinterpret pending electronic receivable as driver cash; block dispatch or provide an explicit owner-approved conversion/recovery workflow.
required_regression_tests: Mixed immediate cash/card plus pending electronic dispatch; assert custody does not include collected leg or silently convert pending claim.
All-immediate Multi and cash COD positive controls; explicit conversion policy only if approved.
acceptance_criteria: Driver custody equals only currently collectible amounts under documented payment contract; pending electronic leg is never silently converted to cash owed.
Block or explicitly convert pending leg only under owner-approved flow, with atomic custody/movement/reporting.

specifications.title: Payroll Advance Calculation Ledger Entry Type Case Mismatch Causes Zero Advance Deductions
specifications.root_cause: Verbatim port of legacy JavaScript lowercase string comparisons ('advance', 'payroll_settlement') in PayrollRules.cs while the C# infrastructure persists PascalCase enum names (nameof(LedgerEntryType.Advance), nameof(LedgerEntryType.PayrollSettlement)).
specifications.impact: Payroll calculation silently skips cash advance deductions; employees receive unreduced net salaries, causing immediate financial loss to the restaurant.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Update PayrollRules.OutstandingAdvance to check string equality using StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase or match against nameof(LedgerEntryType.Advance) / nameof(LedgerEntryType.PayrollSettlement).
required_regression_tests: Create employee cash advance with Type="Advance" (Debit=500 EGP); call PayrollRules.OutstandingAdvance; assert outstanding advance equals 500 EGP.
Add settlement with Type="PayrollSettlement" (AdvanceDeduction=200 EGP); assert outstanding advance reduces to 300 EGP.
acceptance_criteria: PayrollRules.OutstandingAdvance recognizes both PascalCase and lowercase ledger entry type strings.

specifications.title: BusinessClock DST Spring-Forward Transition Causes ArgumentException on Business Date Boundary Calculation
specifications.root_cause: UtcRangeForBusinessDate passes midnight (00:00:00) directly to TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeToUtc without verifying whether the time falls within a daylight saving time spring-forward gap.
specifications.impact: Unhandled System.ArgumentException crashes all API endpoints, reports, and background jobs that calculate date ranges for the last Friday of April (and the preceding Thursday when computing range end).
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Before calling ConvertTimeToUtc, check CairoTimeZone.IsInvalidTime(localMidnight). If true, adjust forward by the DST gap (e.g. 1 hour to 01:00:00) or calculate the UTC instant using TimeZoneInfo.GetUtcOffset with gap tolerance.
required_regression_tests: Call BusinessClock.UtcRangeForBusinessDate with DateOnly(2024, 4, 26) and DateOnly(2025, 4, 25); assert method returns valid UTC range without throwing System.ArgumentException.
Call BusinessClock.UtcRangeForBusinessDate with the preceding Thursday; assert method returns valid UTC range without throwing ArgumentException.
acceptance_criteria: BusinessClock.UtcRangeForBusinessDate handles DST spring-forward boundary dates without throwing System.ArgumentException and maintains continuous UTC coverage.

specifications.title: Payroll Advance Deduction Missing from Employee Ledger Posting and Ledger Schema
specifications.root_cause: EmployeeLedgerEntryEntity lacks an AdvanceDeduction column and PayPayrollHandler only posts net settlement debit without recording the advance deduction component into the employee ledger.
specifications.impact: Outstanding employee advance balance is never credited or reduced in the ledger when payroll is disbursed; ledger reports continue to show the advance as unpaid, leading to double deductions or accounting discrepancies.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Add an AdvanceDeductionPiastres column to EmployeeLedgerEntryEntity and update PayPayrollHandler to record the advance deduction amount on the posted settlement entry or post a distinct advance recovery entry.
required_regression_tests: Execute payroll run with an employee having advance deduction; execute PayPayrollHandler; assert EmployeeLedgerEntry records advance deduction and reduces outstanding advance.
acceptance_criteria: Payroll settlement postings in EmployeeLedger record both net payable payout and advance deduction recovery.

specifications.title: Previously admitted treasury deposit can post after authoritative business-day close
specifications.root_cause: Financial write admission is validated outside its monetary transaction and no shared day-state lock, revision predicate, or revalidation is visible in the selected path. Close snapshot and blocker reads therefore do not source-demonstrably drain operations that already passed the gate.
specifications.impact: Predicted post-snapshot movement/journal attached to a now-closed day, potentially diverging from its authoritative close-time snapshot if post-close activity is forbidden. This is not an observed SQL interleaving or loss.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Confirm whether financial writes are forbidden after close. If yes, coordinate day admission in the database: acquire a transaction-held lock/revision on the business-day row and revalidate Open within each financial write transaction; close takes the same lock before blocker evaluation/snapshot and waits for already-admitted writes. Define cross-process semantics, retry policy, and consistent lock order. If late postings are allowed, define how frozen snapshot reconciliation and subsequent deltas are represented instead of silently treating snapshot as current ledger.
required_regression_tests: SQL-backed barrier test pauses deposit after initial lookup; close wins; resumed deposit must reject with zero journal/movement.
Reverse schedule: admitted deposit commits first and close waits/includes it in snapshot.
Cover other financial commands using the same admission contract plus reopen/new-day and idempotent replay.
Run controlled multi-process concurrency test under the supported provider/isolation level; verify no stale admission slips.
acceptance_criteria: A documented policy distinguishes immutable close-time snapshot from permitted subsequent postings.
Under forbid-after-close policy, every monetary write serializes/revalidates against close inside the database transaction; close snapshot covers all writes admitted before close.
Concurrency tests prove both orderings and absence of partial or post-close financial effects; lock order avoids deadlocks.

specifications.title: Standalone employee settlements remain payable through frozen period payroll
specifications.root_cause: PayrollRules computes payroll from earning categories and named deductions but ignores standalone Settlement debits. PayEmployee reduces current balance, while CreatePayroll freezes period net and PayPayroll pays that frozen amount without revalidating outstanding employee balance.
specifications.impact: If standalone Settlement is a prepayment of earnings already included in the same frozen payroll, paying both paths can disburse the same obligation twice; source flow shows this mechanism but does not establish the accounting policy or an actual duplicate payout.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Owner decision first. If settlements prepay same-period earnings, derive remaining liability from an explicit period/earning obligation and apply settlements both before payroll calculation and after run freeze; if the two paths are mutually exclusive, enforce atomic exclusion on both. Preserve frozen-run, replay, audit, source-balance, and historical-record behavior.
required_regression_tests: Create earnings, settle same obligation standalone, then create/approve/pay payroll; total disbursement must satisfy owner-approved invariant.
Create/approve payroll, apply standalone settlement, then pay frozen payroll; same invariant.
Unrelated-period settlement must not be netted.
Repeat and concurrent requests with distinct IDs; validate exactly-once employee ledger and treasury effects in approved disposable SQL Server integration DB.
acceptance_criteria: Written owner policy defines relationship between standalone Settlement and period payroll obligation.
Tests implement that policy across both sequence orders, period boundaries, retries and concurrent requests.
No duplicate obligation disbursement if policy treats Settlement as prepayment; otherwise distinct obligation is explicitly represented and reported.

specifications.title: Concurrent pay/cancel can overwrite payroll terminal status
specifications.root_cause: Pay and cancel authorize from independent Approved snapshots; no shared run-level transaction lock, compare-and-swap state predicate, or concurrency token is visible. Payment protects source-account balance, not PayrollRun state.
specifications.impact: Predicted inconsistent final state: a payroll can be financially paid while status becomes Cancelled, or payment can proceed after cancellation. Downstream reporting/recreation decisions become unreliable. Do not claim duplicate payment reproduced; same-run payment idempotency is counterevidence to duplicate pay on replay.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Use one database-coordinated PayrollRun state transition primitive for pay/cancel (transaction-held run-row lock or optimistic concurrency token/conditional Approved-to-claimed update). Payment must acquire/claim Approved within its transaction before movement/ledger posting; cancellation must perform mutually exclusive conditional transition. A losing operation must produce no movement, journal, settlement, paid-line, or status side effects. Preserve idempotency, filtered live-period index, and consistent treasury/run lock ordering.
required_regression_tests: Barrier: pay reads Approved, cancel commits first; payment claim must fail and leave zero financial rows/line effects.
Barrier: cancellation reads Approved, payment claims/commits first; cancellation must fail and Paid status/effects remain consistent.
Repeat same idempotency key and concurrent duplicate pay; only one movement and one settlement per line.
Exercise cancellation and replacement-run creation against filtered live-period unique index.
Assert state and all side effects atomically under production provider and supported isolation.
acceptance_criteria: At most one of pay/cancel succeeds for a given Approved version.
Paid state is committed atomically with movement, journal, line settlements and audit; Cancelled state cannot coexist with those effects from the losing race.
Lost race yields explicit conflict/reload response and no partial writes.
Existing retry idempotency and one-live-run policy remain intact.

specifications.title: Requested two-stage pickup preparation and final payment lifecycle is absent
specifications.root_cause: Creation, stock consumption and payment checkout share one use case (CheckoutOrderHandler); only Delivery Cash has explicit deferred cash rule. No state machine exists for pay-on-collection pickup orders.
specifications.impact: Operational gap: Kitchen cannot be notified to prepare pickup orders before payment has been taken in full, blocking customer phone/advance pickup workflows.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Design separate pickup fulfilment state and payment state with server-authoritative transitions (two-stage reserve-and-prep -> pay-and-handover).
required_regression_tests: Recommend lifecycle acceptance tests: unpaid reservation queues kitchen once, payment later posts once, handover only after policy gate, cancellation/restock/close blockers, network replay at each stage.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: In-Memory Full Table Pull on StockMovements in ListInventoryItemsAsync
specifications.root_cause: Full table read into RAM instead of server-side SQL GROUP BY aggregation.
specifications.impact: Severe memory spikes, thread blocking, and database timeouts as stock movements accumulate.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Perform GROUP BY and conditional SUM at the database level via EF Core / SQL query.
required_regression_tests: Inspect SQL generated by ListInventoryItemsAsync; assert GROUP BY InventoryItemId is executed on SQL Server.
acceptance_criteria: Stock balance calculation aggregates in SQL database engine rather than loading full table into memory.

specifications.title: Inventory Deduction / Order Refund Restock Synchronization Gap
specifications.root_cause: RefundOrderHandler does not interact with InventoryDeductionService or emit Return/Restock movements when an order is cancelled or refunded.
specifications.impact: Stock balances diverge permanently from physical inventory whenever items are refunded or returned.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Introduce restock movement option in RefundOrderHandler to credit inventory upon refund of sellable items.
required_regression_tests: Refund order with sellable items; assert Return StockMovements are recorded with Direction = In.
acceptance_criteria: Refund workflow optionally synchronizes returned physical inventory back into stock balances.

specifications.title: Two machines can submit the same pending kitchen job
specifications.root_cause: CreatePrintJobsHandler.cs generates job ID using request.RequestId, and PrintJobs table in FalahDbContext lacks a composite unique constraint on (OrderId, Route).
specifications.impact: Duplicate kitchen and receipt tickets printed when multiple stations submit print requests for the same order.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Add composite unique index on (OrderId, Route, DocumentKind) in PrintJobEntity configuration, or ensure idempotent deduplication at database level.
required_regression_tests: Existing PrintAgentTests cover route selection and one-agent report retry only; add concurrent two-agent claim/fencing test, and replacement-agent unknown-outcome recovery.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Printer verification tool can delete preexisting restaurant tickets
specifications.root_cause: Generic document-name matching replaces exact submission ownership; ignored pause result invalidates no-paper guarantee.
specifications.impact: Tool pauses printer without checking success, sends generic Falah ticket, then removes every job with DocumentName Falah ticket and resumes queue.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Use dedicated test queue and exact returned job ID, verify pause state, never delete by document name; keep all live printer operations gated.
required_regression_tests: Add fake queue fixture preserving preexisting IDs, failure-to-pause abort, failed-cleanup no-resume policy. Only isolated queue integration after approval.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: PIN-bearing user-management requests are durably stored as unencrypted JSON
specifications.root_cause: FileRetainedRequestStore.cs in CashierWinUI and CallCenterWinUI writes raw in-flight request payloads to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Falah\pending-operations\{station}\{ownerKey}.json as unencrypted plaintext JSON. User creation, PIN changes, and manager overrides that run while offline or mid-dispatch persist plaintext PINs on disk.
specifications.impact: Workstation credential exposure. Anyone with read access to the local machine's user directory (%LOCALAPPDATA%) can read persistent and in-flight employee and manager PINs in plaintext.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Encrypt retained request payloads using Windows Data Protection API (ProtectedData.Protect with CurrentUser scope) prior to file write. Mask or redact PIN properties from retained request diagnostic envelopes.
required_regression_tests: Execute CreateUser or PIN change request in CashierWinUI while offline; inspect persisted JSON in %LOCALAPPDATA%; assert payload is ciphertext and PIN is unreadable in plaintext.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Authenticated employee reads expose complete sensitive profiles without employee permission or self-access restriction
specifications.root_cause: GET /api/employees and GET /api/employees/{employeeId} in Program.cs (lines 685-687) have no permission policy attribute. EmployeeQueryService.cs (lines 81-85) unconditionally projects all database columns (NationalId, DailyWagePiastres, MonthlySalaryPiastres, OvertimeRatePiastres, FingerprintId, Address, Phone) into EmployeeDto.
specifications.impact: Internal data exposure. Any authenticated terminal session (including frontline cashiers, waiters, delivery drivers) can query the exact salaries, overtime rates, national IDs, and home addresses of all restaurant staff.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Introduce PublicEmployeeSummaryDto for operational cashier selection. Restrict GET /api/employees full profile to callers possessing 'employees_manage' or 'payroll_view' permissions.
required_regression_tests: Query GET /api/employees with cashier bearer token; assert response contains only public summary fields and omits salary/national ID.
Query GET /api/employees with manager bearer token; assert full profile is returned.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Manager Approval Tokens Lack Expiration (TTL) Check
specifications.root_cause: ValidateApproval has no TTL check on ApprovedAtUtc. A manager approval issued for an aborted action can be stockpiled and replayed days or weeks later.
specifications.impact: Delayed unauthorized refunds, expense withdrawals, or comped orders executed outside real-time managerial oversight.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Pass DateTimeOffset nowUtc into AuthorizationPolicy.ValidateApproval and reject approvals older than a configurable TTL (e.g., 15 minutes).
required_regression_tests: Validate approval issued 16 minutes prior; assert DomainException('انتهت صلاحية اعتماد المدير').
Validate approval within 15 minutes; assert success.
acceptance_criteria: Manager approvals expire after 15 minutes if unconsumed.

specifications.title: PIN Uniqueness Check-Then-Act Race Condition
specifications.root_cause: PIN uniqueness check is performed in application memory across salted PBKDF2 hashes without an atomic database isolation lock.
specifications.impact: Duplicate PINs across active accounts, leading to non-deterministic login resolution where LoginByPin authenticates the first matching account.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Wrap user creation and PIN modification inside a transaction with serializable isolation or table lock, or maintain a deterministic blind-index hash.
required_regression_tests: Execute concurrent CreateUser requests with identical PINs; assert second request fails with DomainException('رمز PIN مستخدم بالفعل').
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent user creation or PIN modification cannot assign colliding PINs.

specifications.title: User Reactivation Missing PIN Uniqueness Verification
specifications.root_cause: SetUserActiveHandler reactivates account without checking if candidate PIN is currently in use by another active account.
specifications.impact: Duplicate active PINs; operator authentication collision.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: In SetUserActiveHandler, if request.Active is true, verify PIN uniqueness or require PIN reset upon reactivation.
required_regression_tests: Deactivate user A; create user B with user A's PIN; reactivate user A; assert reactivation requires PIN reset or fails with collision error.
acceptance_criteria: Account reactivation validates that stored credentials do not collide with active accounts.

specifications.title: Primary cashier and treasury money requests lose original retry identity on process loss
specifications.root_cause: Normal close/edit gates and same-process fixed keys cannot preserve immutable submitted DTO/key across forced termination. Primary financial partials bypass existing durable helper.
specifications.impact: No reliable station-owned recovery question for original checkout/refund/expense/treasury action; manually repeating with new key can create duplicate real operations. Actual duplicate ledger writes NOT tested.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Persist exact versioned typed financial request and owner before dispatch; expose recovery by original identity, block replacement until outcome known; no fixes performed.
required_regression_tests: Simulate committed-but-lost-response with fake transport, reconstruct actual cashier VM/session with store, assert exact request ID/payload recovered before any new action.
Repeat for refund, expense, safe drop, drawer transfer, shift open/close and treasury operations; assert server ledger unaffected on replay in isolated integration fixture.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Requested pickup kitchen-before-payment stage is absent from active client workflow
specifications.root_cause: Pickup is a detail variant of common checkout, not separate persisted preparation/awaiting-payment state with stage-aware primary command.
specifications.impact: Client cannot perform owner-requested Stage A kitchen ticket then later Stage B checkout on same persisted unpaid pickup. Server/Domain end-to-end corroboration required before claiming global architecture absence.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Design explicit persisted pickup preparation/payment lifecycle using existing backend/domain capabilities where possible; implementation requires separate authorization.
required_regression_tests: Create pickup preparation without payment in isolated backend test; stable ID and no payment movement; initial kitchen exactly once.
Resume same order, collect final money, receipt once; operational pending list hides terminal paid/completed while history remains.
Concurrent stage clicks and ambiguous print/payment responses retain stable identities.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Recovered electronic confirmation/cancellation has no reachable cashier retry context
specifications.root_cause: Retained DTO loads but transient LastCheckoutResult does not; all retry reachability assumes that result. Main session sees unresolved op and blocks lock/navigation/normal close.
specifications.impact: Cashier can become frozen after restart even though retained original order ID exists. Correct production reconciliation must not simply delete journal. Potential cross-user context confusion because keys are station-global.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Recover operation order context from persisted request or present a standalone pending-action recovery panel independent of transient checkout result.
required_regression_tests: Seed fake store with actual ConfirmElectronicPaymentRequest/CancelPendingElectronicPaymentRequest, create fresh AppSession/current user/Cashier VM, assert reachable retry command and UI visible; retry exact order identity.
Confirm no new checkout, result discard or owner change until original outcome resolved; test another operator sees appropriate recovery ownership.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Late CallCenter customer lookup can overwrite a different phone/new order
specifications.root_cause: No requested-phone equality/epoch check after await; async lookup completion mutates latest mutable form regardless of source identity.
specifications.impact: Wrong customer name/address offered under another phone; operator may dispatch wrong destination and upsert mismatched customer data. No real PII or DB writes used to reproduce.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Snapshot normalized phone and monotonic form generation; discard stale responses/cancel on change/reset; clear incompatible resolved fields safely.
required_regression_tests: Deterministic fake HTTP delayed A/B in reverse completion order; assert final name/addresses match B.
Begin lookup then ClearOrder, release response; new form stays blank.
Lookup failure 404 vs timeout must show correct status; changing phone should invalidate old customer/address selections.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: CallCenter customer-copy reprint requests kitchen preparation routes again
specifications.root_cause: CallCenter omitted explicit false flag added to corresponding cashier reprint path.
specifications.impact: Potential duplicate charcoal/grill preparation work and food waste, in addition to requested customer copy. Backend route suppression cross-checked by printing peer as parent reports; parent should attach final handler evidence.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Send false for customer-only reprint; expose explicit separately confirmed kitchen reprint only if requirement exists.
required_regression_tests: CallCenter reprint fake API asserts IncludeKitchenRoutes false.
Isolated print-job handler fixture with grill/charcoal items asserts customer copy only for follow-up; explicit kitchen reprint separate labeled action.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Successful restore is reported incomplete because UI expects Completed instead of Succeeded
specifications.root_cause: UI compares result status to wrong literal Completed; server stores enum Succeeded.
specifications.impact: UI tells operator restore did not complete after database already replaced, leaves restore target shown and can invite repeating dangerous operation. No restore executed by reviewer.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Use shared enum/contract success vocabulary and avoid treating generic HTTP success as outcome proof; maintain strict restore controls.
required_regression_tests: Fake API returns successful DTO Status Succeeded; assert success note, target closed and no false RestoreError.
Blocked/Failed records must remain reported non-success; no production DB restore needed for client contract test.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Management shift actions abandon unknown outcomes and generate a new request identity per retry
specifications.root_cause: Separate management presentation did not adopt cashier immutable pending/outcomeUnknown protocol; only own busy booleans, no session registration or retained key.
specifications.impact: Cannot safely reconcile original shift operation; new attempt may be rejected by single-open/already-closed server guards or mislead state, and user can abandon in-flight money context. Actual duplicate server shift transaction not claimed.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Share durable operation coordination between both shift presentations and register global pending before dispatch.
required_regression_tests: Fake commit-lost-response, retry asserts identical typed DTO/key and immutable counted/opening cash.
Root TryClose/Lock/Shell.Navigate blocked while management open/close busy or unresolved.
First definite rejection permits correction/new attempt, unknown requires same attempt reconciliation.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Recovered payroll transition or payment cannot reach its retry command
specifications.root_cause: Durable DTO recovery is not accompanied by run selection/pay-dialog reconstruction; all routes to restore context blocked by same pending state.
specifications.impact: Retained financial operation stranded; ordinary page cannot reconcile original status/payment. Unlike create-run retained branch, no standalone retry in this VM.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Recover run/visible action from stored request or expose generic pending-action verification independent of transient selection.
required_regression_tests: Fake retained transition/pay DTO, construct fresh VM/session, assert explicit retry available without selecting new run/account.
Read original target by stored identity and show original intended action; exact DTO resends; no new payment until resolved.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Late recipe-detail response can replace another recipe selection before editing
specifications.root_cause: No version/selected-ID validation around asynchronous recipe detail publishing.
specifications.impact: Wrong ingredient list/recipe identity can be edited and saved, affecting future inventory consumption/costing. Server authorizes a valid recipe update but cannot infer operator intended different selected row. Runtime write not tested.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Use monotonic detail generation and validate again after every await; freeze target identity across edit/save.
required_regression_tests: Fake delayed A/B reverse completion asserts Detail.RecipeId equals SelectedRecipe key and StartEdit uses B.
Close/change selection while reading must invalidate old response/finally flags.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: PIN-change retry proof replaces shared bearer despite preserving visible user identity
specifications.root_cause: LoginByPinAsync has bearer installation side effect, but proof caller assumes read-only credential test and does not reconcile session.CurrentUser.
specifications.impact: HTTP authenticated identity may diverge from UI/current actor; subsequent requests can fail or run under unintended principal depending server actor enforcement. Parent security reviewer owns final exploitability/severity validation; no real login performed.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Use isolated non-session-mutating proof client/endpoint and explicit owner context; coordinate with security report to avoid duplicate final finding.
required_regression_tests: Fake login proof changes token identity tootheruser, assert root session and bearer remain original after failed proof.
Recovered self-PIN request owned by another actor must be visibly routed/blocked; no session switch as side effect.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Late product-image completion changes save target beneath another product form
specifications.root_cause: Image completion unconditionally overwrites shared editor identity captured before await. IsImageBusy only disables image controls; ReloadAsync reloads catalogs but does not reset/rebind visible form or editing identity.
specifications.impact: Save targets product A with B field values/variants. Can corrupt menu pricing, preparation route and recipe association despite valid authorized backend request. No product mutation executed by reviewer.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Keep immutable operation target independent from current editor; only update visible state when selection generation still matches. Coordinate browse/save with image busy and invalidate late completions on close/kind/new.
required_regression_tests: Controlled image TaskCompletionSource: A upload pending, SelectRow(B), complete A; editor target and form must remain B, A image catalog updated separately.
Repeat with delete, New, SetKind and Close/reopen; no stale completion alters current draft.
Assert saved product ID matches displayed selected item after every async completion.
specifications.acceptance_criteria: Invariant holds under retries and concurrent executions.

specifications.title: Backup filenames collide within a second and WITH FORMAT can overwrite prior backup
specifications.root_cause: Second-resolution timestamp treated as unique filename; no GUID/exclusive reservation. Retention reasons over records not unique physical paths.
specifications.impact: Two backup creations within timestamp resolution can target the same physical filename; later WITH FORMAT may overwrite a previously recorded backup or fail, while retention may count multiple records for one path.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Use collision-resistant immutable backup identity and exclusive create/no-overwrite destination semantics; preserve record-to-file identity. Retention should validate distinct canonical paths and never delete a file still referenced by a retained record.
required_regression_tests: Parallel same-time filename generation returns distinct IDs/paths.
Existing destination collision refuses overwrite.
Retention with duplicate path references preserves all retained valid backups.
Later isolated SQL/media test only with explicit approval.
acceptance_criteria: Each successful backup record resolves to a unique immutable artifact.
A collision cannot silently overwrite a prior artifact; retention cannot delete a retained target.

specifications.title: Concurrent different open-day requests create multiple active business days
specifications.root_cause: Single-active invariant protected only by read check; no shared singleton lock or unique active-day representation.
specifications.impact: Concurrent requests with distinct open-day IDs can both pass read-before-write admission, leaving multiple active business days; queries/gates selecting first active day may attach new finance to inconsistent periods.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Represent single active ownership with a database-enforced singleton/unique active-state key acquired transactionally by open and reopen. Reconcile existing duplicate active rows explicitly before constraint migration; make read gate fail closed if invariant is corrupt.
required_regression_tests: Concurrent opens with distinct IDs: exactly one active day; same request replay returns same day.
Race reopen versus open; exactly one active day.
Corrupt duplicate fixture makes gate fail closed and emits diagnosable error.
acceptance_criteria: At most one active day exists across app processes.
Open/reopen admission and all active-day readers use the same ownership invariant.

specifications.title: Collected sales report drops immediate money from pending mixed payments
specifications.root_cause: Any pending electronic leg triggers subtraction of whole order total, instead of pending leg amount; report contradicts own cash channel totals.
specifications.impact: Sales report may subtract full order amount while an electronic leg is pending even though immediate cash/card leg was collected, understating collected sales/revenue and contradicting channel reconciliation.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Compute pending collection as the pending leg amount(s) and separately report gross/net sale recognition from tender settlement timing. Do not infer collection solely from order IsPaid or subtract whole order for partial pending tender.
required_regression_tests: Mixed cash/electronic and card/electronic pending: collected amount equals immediate leg and pending equals deferred leg.
After confirm, totals conserve order amount across channels.
Compare report totals to treasury movements and payment query for each state.
acceptance_criteria: For each order, collected plus pending amounts reconcile to eligible tender total; no collected leg disappears while another awaits confirmation.

specifications.title: Owner dashboard adds outgoing stock instead of subtracting it
specifications.root_cause: OwnerDashboardQueryService.cs calculates inventory stock movements by summing QuantityMilliUnits without multiplying by -1 when Direction == Out.
specifications.impact: Inventory stock overstatement on owner dashboard. Waste and sales increase stock totals rather than decreasing them.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Apply proper sign negation: (m.Direction == StockMovementDirection.Out ? -m.QuantityMilliUnits : m.QuantityMilliUnits).
required_regression_tests: Seed positive-magnitude In and Out movements plus count adjustments/waste; dashboard balance and low-stock set equal inventory overview.
Cover zero/negative normalized inputs and multiple movement kinds.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard stock projection equals canonical inventory balance for every item.
Out never increases available quantity; count corrections are treated per shared domain rule.

specifications.title: Financial approval provenance can retain unvalidated shift presenter or discard verified driver variance approver
specifications.root_cause: Financial attribution derives from presentation or earlier base gate rather than the actual verified relevant authorization result. Original shift evidence and related driver variance variant are preserved separately.
specifications.impact: False attribution to a person who did not issue approval; no money change or otherwise forbidden operation authorized by this defect alone.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Carry verified gate result, actor, and actual approver identity separately to all financial rows/audit; preserve OR authorization policy and approval reason semantics.
required_regression_tests: Direct-permission below-threshold unnecessary presenter; above-threshold approved variance; verify actor/approver on movement, close event, settlement and audit.
Wrong action/consumed approval and permission-only actor controls.
acceptance_criteria: Persisted approver attribution is the verified approver for the actual gate; actor and approver are distinct fields where required.
Below-threshold optional presentation cannot be misattributed; above-threshold approval still enforces approval action, reason, and amount.

specifications.title: Negative receipt quantity and unit cost can post stock reduction with supplier debt
specifications.root_cause: Aggregate payment validation substituted for per-line positive receipt quantity/nonnegative purchase cost validation.
specifications.impact: Incorrect stock reduction labelled receipt and positive supplier debt for invalid purchase; unauthorized privilege escalation not claimed.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Validate direction-specific positive receipt quantities and nonnegative costs before posting. If returns are required, implement a separate explicit return/credit-note flow rather than encoding them as receipt negatives.
required_regression_tests: Negative qty with positive unit cost; positive qty with negative cost; both-negative combination; assert no stock/debt mutation.
Positive receipt and distinct authorized return flow.
acceptance_criteria: Receipt rejects unsupported negative quantity/unit-cost combinations before posting stock or supplier debt.
Valid positive receipts and any approved return/credit workflow remain coherent and atomic.

specifications.title: First stock receipt can race unit-change admission and reinterpret movement history
specifications.root_cause: Immutable-unit predicate is evaluated before write without coordinating the first stock-movement admission. InventoryItem mapping244 is primary key only, no concurrency token; movement FK protects existence, not unit interpretation.
specifications.impact: Historical bare milliunit movement is reinterpreted under UnitB, contrary explicit InventoryRules40-47 no-unit-snapshot invariant. Current stock display joins current Unit, and valuation/recipe conversions can become semantically inconsistent; no measured monetary loss or actual SQL schedule executed.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Coordinate unit edits and first movement admission through a shared DB transaction lock/revision invariant used by both edit and every movement writer. Version only works if both paths participate.
required_regression_tests: Barrier first movement admission vs unit change; ensure at most one incompatible operation commits.
Sequential post-first-movement unit change rejection and legitimate same-unit metadata update.
acceptance_criteria: A unit change and first movement cannot both pass against same pre-movement state; one is rejected or serialized.
All readers continue to interpret historical movements using stable unit semantics.

specifications.title: Accepted numeric Inclusive tax mode is persisted raw and consumed as Exclusive
specifications.root_cause: Validation discards parsed TaxMode and persists noncanonical raw string; three amount consumers silently map every nonliteralInclusive value toExclusive, including accepted definedInclusive numeric0.
specifications.impact: Future selected enabled tax computation can add tax to a base intended inclusive under its accepted enum interpretation. Legitimate settings authority and noncanonical input required; no actual charge or SQL acceptance reproduced.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Persist parsed TaxMode canonical enum value, reject undefined/unsupported forms, and make consumers use canonical parsed mode. Keep historical order tax snapshots frozen.
required_regression_tests: Create/update tax mode canonical and numeric/invalid enum forms; compare checkout and estimate at nonzero rate.
Ensure old orders frozen.
acceptance_criteria: Accepted tax mode is parsed and persisted canonically; every consumer computes same intended inclusive/exclusive treatment.
Historical frozen orders unchanged; new checkout and estimate agree under enabled nonzero rate.

specifications.title: Accepted case-insensitive compensation type is stored raw but wage/payroll consumers require canonical names
specifications.root_cause: Shared compensation enum validation accepts multiple spellings but persistence retainsrawstring, while two financial consumers use exactname comparison instead of the parsedmeaning.
specifications.impact: Accepted case-variant compensation metadata can omit automatic daily wage credits or classify a monthly salary as credit-based; positive configured wage and noncanonical accepted input required. Shipped editor emits canonical names. No actual payout/loss reproduced.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Persist parsed CompensationType canonical value and use parsed enum in attendance/payroll consumers; validate defined supported types at API boundary.
required_regression_tests: Case variants for Daily/Monthly/Hourly on attendance and payroll; malformed/undefined strings rejected.
Canonical values and manual wage posting remain correct.
acceptance_criteria: Every accepted compensation value is persisted in one canonical representation used consistently by attendance and payroll.
Daily/monthly/Hourly cases calculate only intended credits; resaving canonical data does not change financial meaning.

specifications.title: Attendance checkout reconstructs check-in on checkout UTC date and can omit overtime
specifications.root_cause: Loss of check-in UTC date, followed by reconstruction from checkout UTC date despite selecting attendance by Cairo date.
specifications.impact: Wrong hours and possible omission of otherwise eligible automatic overtime; no actual payment/loss or payroll record measured. Distinct from FIN012 correction-credit classification and FIN022 compensation enum interpretation.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Retain full check-in date/time and compute elapsed interval from that persisted event under documented timezone and repeated-punch policy; do not reconstruct from checkout date.
required_regression_tests: Same UTC and cross-Cairo-date check-in/out examples; work hours/overtime against approved time zone rule.
Repeated check-ins establish first/last punch rule.
acceptance_criteria: Checkout time is compared against original check-in date/time policy, preserving timezone/day boundary; eligible overtime calculation matches approved rule.
Repeated check-in/checkout policy is explicit; same-UTC-day positive control remains correct.

specifications.title: Manual daily-wage and overtime commands admit negative earning credits
specifications.root_cause: Signed custom wage/rate is used as earning Credit without command-specific sign validation; positive finitehours do not ensure positive earning.
specifications.impact: An otherwise authorized accepted command can construct negative DailyWage/Overtime credit, reducing employee factbalance and categorized earnings instead of explicit deduction. No actual SQL write/payroll loss verified.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Reject negative command-specific wage/rate and overflow before posting; define zero policy. Do not globally ban signed Money or clamp negative earnings into zero.
required_regression_tests: Negative custom daily rate/overtime rate and negative configured wage; overflow bounds; zero-policy control.
Same-key retry and manual explicit deduction controls.
acceptance_criteria: Negative earning rate/amount and unsupported overflow reject before ledger write; accepted zero behavior follows explicit policy.
Manual deductions remain explicit and valid; valid wage/overtime/extra-shift replay remains idempotent.

specifications.title: Manual ledger accepts undefined numeric types excluded from named financial categories
specifications.root_cause: Enum.TryParse result is canonicalized without Enum.IsDefined/supported-category admission; undefined numeric strings remain unnamed numeric types.
specifications.impact: Constructed ledger facts can affect all-entry balance but fall outside explicit report/payroll namecategories. This is unsupported data-shape acceptance, not a claim every legitimate named credit belongs in payroll. No API/SQLacceptance test.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Require Enum.IsDefined plus an explicit supported-type/credit-debit policy before manual ledger posting; preserve valid named types and classify legacy unsupported values explicitly.
required_regression_tests: Defined numeric enum vs named control; unsupported numeric 999; explicit credit/debit category reporting.
Balance, payroll and report reconciliation after accepted entry.
acceptance_criteria: Only defined and explicitly supported ledger enum members/types can be posted through manual API.
Unsupported numeric strings reject or are explicitly classified before balance/report/payroll effects; canonical named controls remain valid.

specifications.title: Distinct employee credit requests can persist and display stale running-balance snapshots
specifications.root_cause: BalanceAfter snapshot computed from readsum before Save without cross-command employee serialization; own pendingDelta and same-key dedup do not cover different writers.
specifications.impact: Source schedule retains both positive credit facts but can display wrong statement runningbalance. Fact-derived GetBalance remains correct; protected payout locks are counterevidence. No actual SQLrace/UI observation/moneyoverdraft proved.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Either serialize all ledger appends on one employee anchor with consistent lock order, or compute statement running balance from ordered immutable facts and retire stale BalanceAfter as authority. Define deterministic timestamp tie-breaker.
required_regression_tests: Barrier concurrent distinct positive credit appends with no rows and existing balance; verify facts and statement snapshots.
Same-key retry, rollback/restart, same-command pending rows, payout lock ordering, equal timestamp tie.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent distinct credit appends preserve correct recomputed employee balance and statement running-balance order.
Same-key replay, pending same-command rows, and locked payout remain correct; tie ordering is deterministic.

specifications.title: Frozen business-day financial snapshots omit the corresponding live-report permission gate
specifications.root_cause: Frozen report payload endpoint/client path uses session-only admission instead of live reports_view/all policy.
specifications.impact: Authenticated actor lacking report permission can receive financial report JSON from snapshot endpoints under the inspected source contract. Different from employee report or identity-binding issues; parent owns dedup/security disposition.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Apply reports_view to latest/history financial snapshot reads using verified authenticated actor; if broader archive access is intended, define a distinct explicit permission rather than reusing control-center permission.
required_regression_tests: Disposable authenticated requests with and without reports_view for latest/history snapshot routes.
Client control-center-only access sees no financial figures; permitted report viewer still accesses.
acceptance_criteria: Every frozen financial snapshot read uses authenticated session actor plus reports_view (or a separately owner-approved explicit archive permission).
Unauthorized session receives no financial snapshot payload; authorized reader can still access permitted history.

specifications.title: Spent manager approval prevents acknowledgement replay of committed overtime and extra-shift credits
specifications.root_cause: RecordOvertime/RecordExtraShift validate one-use delegated approval before deterministic ledger receipt lookup. Successful first SaveChanges persists approval consumption; retry with same saved approval rejects before ledger dedupe/replay.
specifications.impact: Existing financial credit remains committed but client cannot confirm it with original request. Retained request remains pending after subsequent422, preventing normal completion of that submitted action. This is a recovery/acknowledgement failure, not proven duplicate payment or loss of financial facts.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: After validating actor/session and binding the durable request to target and payload, resolve an existing committed receipt before consuming approval again. Keep fresh-operation approval and atomic persistence.
required_regression_tests: Manager-approved overtime/extra shift success then exact retry in fresh context after response loss; verify no second approval spend and same receipt.
Mismatched actor/employee/amount conflict; concurrent same-key SQL test only in approved disposable DB.
acceptance_criteria: A committed approval-backed overtime/extra-shift request can be acknowledged on exact same actor/target/payload retry without consuming another approval.
Mismatched same key conflicts; fresh operation still requires valid authorization; no duplicate ledger credit.

specifications.title: Owner dashboard stock projection ignores outbound movement direction
specifications.root_cause: OwnerDashboardQueryService.LoadStockAsync groups stock movements and sums QuantityMilliUnits without applying Direction. Stock movement writers store positive magnitudes with Direction separately; canonical inventory projections subtract Out movements.
specifications.impact: Dashboard stock balances can be overstated after consumption, waste, packaging usage, or outbound count adjustments. Low-stock rows/counts can be hidden. Example: In 5,000 plus Out 4,000 yields dashboard 9,000 while correct balance is 1,000.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Use shared direction-aware stock balance projection or apply Direction sign in dashboard query; keep inventory overview as parity oracle.
required_regression_tests: Integration compare dashboard/inventory seeded In+Out and outbound-only; low-stock parity; positive in/out count adjustment.
acceptance_criteria: For seeded In 5000 and Out 4000, dashboard and inventory overview both show 1000 and agree on low-stock status.
Outbound-only and count-adjustment movements preserve direction-aware parity.

specifications.title: Arithmetic Overflow Exception in Money.Abs() on long.MinValue
specifications.root_cause: Direct invocation of Math.Abs(Piastres) without handling long.MinValue boundary edge condition in Money.Abs().
specifications.impact: Unhandled System.OverflowException crashes execution if a long.MinValue piastres value is encountered.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Add guard in Money.Abs(): if (Piastres == long.MinValue) throw new DomainException("Cannot compute absolute value of minimum long piastres"); or clamp safely.
required_regression_tests: Assert.Throws<DomainException>(() => Money.FromPiastres(long.MinValue).Abs()); or assert bounded behavior without unhandled OverflowException.
acceptance_criteria: Money.Abs() handles or rejects long.MinValue safely without unhandled System.OverflowException.

specifications.title: Unvalidated Negative Delivery Service Fee Allows Artificially Reduced Order Payable Total
specifications.root_cause: Delivery service creation and update endpoints lack validation asserting FeePiastres >= 0, and CheckoutRules does not guard against negative delivery fee amounts.
specifications.impact: Negative delivery service fees can be injected to artificially deflate order payable totals, leading to cash drawer shortages and corrupted financial journal entries.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Add validation in CreateDeliveryServiceHandler, UpdateDeliveryServiceHandler, and DeliveryServiceRequests validating FeePiastres >= 0; add domain assertion in CheckoutRules asserting deliveryFee.IsPositive || deliveryFee.IsZero.
required_regression_tests: Submit CreateDeliveryServiceRequest with FeePiastres = -100; assert validation fails with DomainException or 400 Bad Request.
Invoke CheckoutRules.ComputePayableTotal with negative delivery fee; assert DomainException is thrown.
acceptance_criteria: Delivery service fees cannot be negative anywhere in the domain or persistence layer.

specifications.title: BusinessDayCloseEvaluator Performs Global Unbounded Table Scans Blocking Business Day Close on Historical Data
specifications.root_cause: BusinessDayCloseEvaluator queries shifts, driver custodies, and financial journal entries without predicate scoping to the target business day or date.
specifications.impact: An unclosed shift or outstanding custody from an old date permanently blocks closing any subsequent business day; queries degrade as tables grow.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Add WHERE predicates restricting shifts and driver custodies to the specific business day being closed (e.g. s.BusinessDate == day.BusinessDate or s.BusinessDayId == day.Id), and scope journal checks to the relevant window.
required_regression_tests: Seed an unclosed shift on date D-1 and an open shift on date D; close date D shift; call EvaluateAsync for date D; assert unclosed shift from D-1 does not block day close for date D.
acceptance_criteria: BusinessDayCloseEvaluator only evaluates blockers relevant to the target business day and executes bounded queries.

specifications.title: PurchasingQueryService Performs Unbounded Full Table Scan on Supplier Ledger Entries in ListSuppliersAsync
specifications.root_cause: ListSuppliersAsync fetches the entire SupplierLedgerEntries table into memory instead of computing supplier ledger balance aggregations via SQL GROUP BY in the database.
specifications.impact: Memory consumption scales linearly O(N) with the entire historical purchasing ledger; causes out-of-memory crashes and severe database contention as supplier ledger entries grow.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Replace the full-table memory load with an EF Core query that groups by SupplierId and aggregates Debit and Credit sums directly in SQL Server.
required_regression_tests: Seed 10,000 SupplierLedgerEntries across 50 suppliers; verify ListSuppliersAsync generates a grouped SQL query and executes in bounded memory without loading all entity instances into memory.
acceptance_criteria: ListSuppliersAsync does not load full ledger table into memory and derives supplier totals via database aggregation.

specifications.title: Multi-Payment Order Refund Inability in Cashier UI and Backend Domain Exception on Treasury Allocation
specifications.root_cause: The Cashier UI hard-disables refunds for orders with PaymentMethod == "multi", and TreasuryMovementFactory lacks treasury allocation rules for multi-method refunds.
specifications.impact: Cashiers cannot process legitimate returns for customers who paid using mixed tenders (e.g. Cash + InstaPay); backend throws DomainException if invoked directly.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Obtain restaurant owner business decision on multi-payment refund settlement rules (e.g., refund to cash drawer vs original tender pro-rata). Update UI to allow refund initiation and extend RefundOrderHandler and TreasuryMovementFactory to allocate multi-payment refund legs.
required_regression_tests: Submit refund on multi-payment order with designated tender refund legs; verify appropriate treasury accounts are debited/credited according to owner business policy.
acceptance_criteria: Multi-payment orders can be refunded according to agreed owner business policies without throwing unhandled DomainException.

specifications.title: Distinct concurrent business-day opens can pass pre-insert active-state validation
specifications.root_cause: Active-day admission is a read-check-insert invariant. OpenBusinessDayHandler reads current active rows and invokes BusinessDayRules.Open before a separate insert; there is no shared transaction/conditional state claim, while the schema has uniqueness only by request ID.
specifications.impact: More than one active business day may be persisted, making day attribution, financial close blockers/snapshots, and active-day lookups ambiguous. No actual duplicate day or accounting loss has been reproduced.
specifications.implementation_blueprint: Confirm the invariant scope. If one active BusinessDay is intended, enforce it at the same persistence boundary as the single-open-shift invariant (provider-appropriate active-row uniqueness or a serialized admission row/lock covering Open and Reopen), and make losing admission return a stable conflict without partial side effects. Preserve same-request idempotency. Do not rely solely on a pre-insert read.
required_regression_tests: Barrier-controlled concurrent opens with two distinct RequestIds: at most one active day commits; loser receives a conflict and no second row is created.
Same RequestId replay returns the original day without a second row.
Concurrent reopen of one day and open of another cannot create two active days if global invariant is confirmed.
Sequential open while Open, Closing, or Reopened rejects; after valid close, a new day opens.
